rules.statement: A contract by a minor cannot be rendered valid by ratification under the law of Ceylon, and contracts which are neither certainly to a minor's prejudice nor necessarily for his benefit are voidable and capable of confirmation after majority.
rules.supporting_quote: "The Roman-Dutch law as to ratification of contracts entered by minors does not appear to have been introduced into Ceylon. In Gunasekera Hamine v. Don Baron 2, it was held that a donation cannot be ratified by a minor when he comes of age."
